### Assignments and the hash chain

GraphQL returns tags. The hash-chain id is the inner ANS-104 data item. That id is the SHA-256 of the item's signature. An outer bundle id is a different value. Using the outer id broke the chain on nonces 5771..5794; the inner id closes it. Source: [evidence/p4/20261016T193039Z-p4-0-49999-closed/range-manifest.json](https://github.com/zigengZ/qar-ledger-recovery/blob/main/evidence/p4/20261016T193039Z-p4-0-49999-closed/range-manifest.json).

The link function is `sha256(previous assignment id bytes || previous hash-chain bytes)`, encoded base64url. For the first nonce, the seed is the process id and the assignment id is omitted. The function was read from permaweb/ao commit [`7ba5df7b2e3c8f7e891481b4fe1b0489647cf607`](https://github.com/permaweb/ao/blob/7ba5df7b2e3c8f7e891481b4fe1b0489647cf607/servers/su/src/domain/core/scheduler.rs), `gen_hash_chain`. That tree is later than the 2024 scheduler that wrote the early assignments. A link counts as matched only when the recomputed value equals the next item's `Hash-Chain` tag. Implementation: [recovery/hashchain.py](https://github.com/zigengZ/qar-ledger-recovery/blob/main/recovery/hashchain.py). Nonce 0's `Hash-Chain` equals the SHA-256 of the process id. Source: [evidence/p3/20261016T174856Z-p3a/sample.json](https://github.com/zigengZ/qar-ledger-recovery/blob/main/evidence/p3/20261016T174856Z-p3a/sample.json).

### P6, first attempt — byte gate failed, checkpoint rejected

The evaluator replayed from nonce 2074508 through 2074518. With 300 synthesized 5-minute crons, and again with no crons, the memory SHA-256 matched neither nonce 2074510 nor nonce 2074518. No evaluator error was returned. ### How crons are built

The process tags are `Cron-Interval=5-minutes` and `Cron-Tag-Action=Cron`. A time-based cron matches when `(timestamp_in_seconds - origin_in_seconds) % 300 == 0`. The origin second itself is not a tick. `cronMessagesBetween` walks one second at a time from the left assignment's block timestamp up to, and not including, the right assignment's block timestamp. When the walk reaches a new block, that block's height becomes the cron message's `Block-Height`. The code in this repository is [vendor/drive-cu/src/domain/lib/loadMessages.js](https://github.com/zigengZ/qar-ledger-recovery/blob/main/vendor/drive-cu/src/domain/lib/loadMessages.js), functions `isTimestampOnCron` and `cronMessagesBetweenWith`, from the same `0db88a45` tree.

The scheduler did not return this process's origin. The public scheduler host failed DNS, and the follow-up response was HTTP 403. The cron phase is taken from the three checkpoint timestamps, which are all `second % 300 == 283`. The process block second 1726164008 is phase 8 and does not emit those timestamps. The origin used is `1726163983000` milliseconds. Any origin second congruent to 283 modulo 300 selects the same crons in 2026. Source: `originMs` and `originReason` in [evaluator.json](https://github.com/zigengZ/qar-ledger-recovery/blob/main/evidence/p6/20261017T052333Z-w-eval/evaluator.json).

进程标签是 `Cron-Interval=5-minutes` 和 `Cron-Tag-Action=Cron`。基于时间的 cron 在 `(以秒计的时间戳 - 以秒计的起点) % 300 == 0` 时命中。起点那一秒本身不是一次 tick。`cronMessagesBetween` 从左侧 Assignment 的区块时间戳起，按一秒一步走到右侧 Assignment 的区块时间戳，不包含右侧。走到新区块时，该区块的高度成为这条 cron 消息的 `Block-Height`。仓库里的代码是 [vendor/drive-cu/src/domain/lib/loadMessages.js](https://github.com/zigengZ/qar-ledger-recovery/blob/main/vendor/drive-cu/src/domain/lib/loadMessages.js) 的 `isTimestampOnCron` 和 `cronMessagesBetweenWith`，来自同一棵 `0db88a45` 树。

AI 生成的代码和结论，在哈希、独立回放或逐地址比较对上之后才被接受。不因为模型这么说就接受。最终内存哈希和规范复现哈希后来已经对上。仍然开着、而且不是修订后门禁的，是抵押物数量，以及旧的 `classification_sourced`。未识别进程仍列为 unknown。
